output.summary: A perennial aquatic plant found nearly worldwide in freshwater habitats. It forms dense floating mats of small green discs with dark-red undersides, and rarely flowers. It is hardly used for human nutrition and is not cultivated for it because of contamination, heavy-metal and calcium-oxalate concerns.
